evidence.quote: We propose a $36 million class fund, distributed automatically using Brightline’s membership and payment records, plus $3.5 million in court-approved fees and expenses.
any fees not awarded would augment the class fund rather than revert to Brightline.

summary: Plaintiff’s opening proposal included both a class fund and fees, so fees were negotiated before class relief was settled. Unawarded fees would increase the class fund, creating an explicit mechanical link between fees and class recovery; the transcript does not show a fee-for-relief tradeoff or counsel prioritizing its own compensation. The declaration accurately acknowledges that fees were not discussed only after class relief was agreed.
